result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but a few elements appear visually incomplete or potentially stuck in a loading state.

issues.description: A loading spinner is prominently displayed over the Tokomaru Ramen Bar image, making the restaurant card appear stuck or not fully loaded.
issues.suggestion: Verify that the image/content request completes and remove the spinner once loaded; show a deliberate placeholder if loading is expected.

issues.description: The horizontal category list and the “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel are clipped at the right edge, leaving partial pills/cards and truncated text visible without an obvious carousel affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add visible horizontal-scroll affordance or adjust the carousel padding/scroll behavior so partial items look intentional and remain clearly discoverable.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower restaurant card, leaving the card image visibly cut off behind the navigation area.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the page content or carousel so cards are not obscured by the fixed navigation bar.
